guides.favoredWhen: Built to counter her. Hold passive for Q+W, match TP, punish chains.

keyTips.text: You are built to counter her: respect the player, not just the pick.
She never Q+Ws into a full passive bar: your empowered spell cancels her dash, so hold it.
She spaces with chain: ranged harass is her only safe damage, so dodge laterally.

tips.text: She takes TP and desyncs backs: stay healthier than her, match the timer.
She baits your spells before trading: no spells means no counter, so hold one.
She tracks your passive bar: full means she backs off, so fake with it.
She punishes spent passives: the window is short, so hide it.
Passive held plus backs synced: the LeBlanc who never dodges never wins.

sources.author: pumpTM
sources.rankClaim: Rank 1 LeBlanc, 2941LP Challenger (title); Challenger (profile badge) · LeBlanc main

guides.favoredWhen: Her dashes feed your passive. Hold fear for Es, never waste passive on waves.

keyTips.text: Her dashes refill your passive: every E feeds your fear.
She dodges spells, especially fear on red: marked means death, so mark her.
When stacked, your W cancels dashes: hold it for her E.

tips.text: She pokes without dashing: Qs do not feed the mark, so answer the Qs.
She plays feet-first early: walk her down before blades.
Never waste passive on waves: empty marks invite engages.
She tracks the red glow: passive-up means she backs off, so cast to zone.
Passive fed plus dashes punished: the Akali who always fears you never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: She dodges E with W and never dashes into fear. Vary E, hold fear for commits, answer Charm.

keyTips.text: She dodges E with W speed (about {cd:711:E}): cast where she lands.
She never dashes in while fear is up: every ult dash procs passive into fear, so hold it.
She pokes with Q on wasted cooldowns: never show the full rotation.

tips.text: She plays around your E and W answers it: change the angle.
Your Q poke outranges hers: press range, deny answers.
From 6 she secures vision and plays fog: sweep and hold fear.
You hold fear for her commits: never show it early.
Commits answered with fear plus shield: the Ahri who always dashes blind never wins.

sources.author: Ir.Defender
sources.rankClaim: Grandmaster (profile badge, no title claim) · Vex main

guides.favoredWhen: She heavily outranges you and dodges simple spells. Close range once, land R.

keyTips.text: Hard matchup: your spells are easy to dodge and she heavily outranges you.
She holds max range: outspacing is her whole plan, so break it once.
Your level 6 burst: an R hit can kill, so set it up.

tips.text: She dodges and pokes from range: simple spells, simple sidesteps, so vary yours.
She buys Mercs: tenacity covers one fear, so land the second.
Post-6 she never stands still: R range is death range, so cut it off.
She keeps the range: you cannot answer what you cannot reach, so close once.
Range closed plus burst landed: the Syndra who never respects R never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: He never engages into fear and all-ins when fear and E are spent. Hold one, punish shadows.

keyTips.text: He never engages into fear: your mark wins every contested trade, so show it.
He punishes spent fear after 6: the window opens when the mark fades, so hide it.
Fear down plus E wasted is his all-in: never show both down.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: He out-pokes early: shadow Qs cost HP for free, so dodge laterally.
His W swap dodges empowered fear: hold fear until he lands.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
Post-6 he tracks fear like a summoner: its absence is his engage timer, so fake it.
Fear held into burst: patience with marks beats his shadow windows.

keyTips.text: Play around Doom calling fear as both a trade tool and protection; check whether the passive is ready before stepping into danger.
Keep trades short and built around cooldowns until the ultimate is available; pair a short trade with Ignite as the kill threat once it unlocks.
In ranged matchups, use the range advantage to pressure a last-hit window and avoid extended trades if the opponent's burst cooldowns are ready.

tips.text: Into melee lanes, keep wave control and look for a Mistral Bolt with an attack, Looming Darkness, Mistral Bolt, and attack trade before backing away.
When the matchup is unsafe, clear with Mistral Bolt from range until level six instead of forcing a fight.
Pressure the opponent's last hits with superior range in ranged lanes, then step out before their burst window opens.
Keep vision around mid and avoid dying to ganks; losing gold and experience undermines the lane lead.
At level six, the stronger Shadow Surge plus Ignite combination is the main kill threat, so set up the all-in rather than poking aimlessly.
Once mid priority is established, extend vision into enemy territory and use it to choose jungle skirmishes or objective pressure.
Push a wave before roaming; weak control and poor mobility away from minions make unplanned roams less reliable.
Use Shadow Surge to reach a high-value target and snowball a skirmish when the team can follow.
Pick Vex into squishy teams with dashes, where her fear can interrupt their approach and the ultimate can threaten the backline.
If the matchup is difficult, play for waveclear through level six and then use the ultimate to create map pressure.
Use wards and lane priority to guide which objective or jungle fight the team takes; do not chase low-value fights without vision.
When the enemy burns key crowd control, look for a follow-up engage; otherwise use fear defensively to protect Vex and the allies.
